title: Fixers — the value of pkit::work-tracking:fixers, version 1
description: The data point's companion schema (COR-052 point 5; project-management:DEC-056 point 1). The value says which agent fixes the artefacts of each type: when the default branch leaves an artefact of the type out of date, that agent proposes its answer, and the person decides it. One entry per type. The point is `union`: a project filler may replace an entry, and two capabilities that claim one type are an error naming both. It has no default. A capability contributes its entries as a static `value`, never through a command filler. The version rises only on a change that breaks existing fillers.

id.description: The artefact type the agent fixes (COR-056 point 1): `<component>:<name>` for a component's type, `backbone:<name>` for the backbone's, or a bare name for a project's own. A capability's entry names a type of its own type registry. A project's entry may name any type.

agent.description: The agent that fixes artefacts of the type. A capability's entry names an agent the capability ships, and a project's entry any deployed agent. Either way the agent only proposes: its definition claims no paths (`owns`) and holds no tool that changes existing files or starts agents.

description.description: What the agent keeps true, in plain words a person reads, such as "your pages". The question that asks the person to grant the fixer is built from it, so it reads after "keep" and before "true".
